context: Tests whether the skill causes the agent to correctly design multi-cloud OpenTelemetry Collector deployments. This is complex because each cloud provider has different authentication, networking, and compliance requirements.

checklist.name: Uses cloud-agnostic OpenTelemetry components
checklist.description: The response recommends standard OpenTelemetry receivers and processors that work across clouds (OTLP, prometheus, etc.) rather than cloud-specific collectors. Score zero if solution is cloud-vendor-specific.

checklist.name: Addresses cloud-specific authentication (IAM, Service Accounts)
checklist.description: The response configures authentication for each cloud: AWS IAM roles, GCP Service Accounts, Azure Managed Identities. Must address how credentials are passed to collectors without hardcoding secrets.

checklist.name: Implements per-region or per-cloud aggregation
checklist.description: The architecture includes aggregation strategy: either per-region gateways or centralized collector tiers that aggregate from all clouds. Must explain trade-offs of each approach.

checklist.name: Handles networking constraints (VPCs, Security Groups)
checklist.description: The response addresses cloud-specific networking: AWS security groups, GCP firewall rules, Azure NSGs. Must explain how collectors in different clouds can reach central backend.

checklist.name: Considers compliance and data residency
checklist.description: The response mentions data residency requirements (e.g., EU data must stay in EU) and how collector placement addresses compliance. Partial credit if mentioned, full credit if configured.

checklist.name: Provides cost and operational considerations
checklist.description: The response acknowledges different costs and operational complexity across clouds. Optional but recommended.
